title: 第0021章气血警戒线邪神低语初现第0022章心灵初震净化之力显威

凰溪岛的清晨，总是被一层淡金色的朝阳裹着，咸湿的海风卷着度假区特有的花香，掠过滨海武道场的青石板地面。
此刻，偌大的武道场上已经挤满了人，密密麻麻的少年少女身着统一的黑色武道服，胸口印着凰溪岛武道馆的徽记，一个个面色紧绷，目光死死盯着场中央那台半人高的气血测试仪。
今天，是凰溪岛武道馆月度气血复测的日子。
对于这群即将冲击武道高考的少年而言，气血值就是命，是未来，是能不能从底层爬进主城武道大学的唯一门票。灵气复苏百年，蓝星早已用实力划分阶层，气血破百是武者门槛，破三百能入三流学府，破五百才有资格冲击顶尖武道大学，而低于五十，便是被宣判死刑的武道废柴，这辈子都只能困在凰溪岛底层，甚至随时可能被废土边境的异兽吞掉，或是被都市深处的诡异拖入心灵地狱。
贾黑米站在队伍的最末尾，缩着肩膀，尽量让自己不那么显眼。
他今年十八岁，土生土长的凰溪岛人，父母在他十岁那年死于一场突如其来的“游客发狂事件”——后来他才知道，那不是发狂，是被邪神低语啃穿了心灵漏洞，变成了没有理智的行尸走肉。从那以后，贾黑米就靠着岛边小餐馆的零工勉强度日，住在度假区最破旧的渔寮里，每天啃着干硬的面饼，凑钱来武道馆蹭最低等的气血修炼法。
可天赋这东西，从来都不讲道理。
贾黑米的气血值，从十五岁测出四十二之后，整整三年，纹丝不动。
四十二。
死死卡在警戒线之下，连参加武道高考预选的资格都没有。
周围的目光，有嘲讽，有鄙夷，有冷漠，像一根根细针，扎在贾黑米的背上。他低着头，看着自己洗得发白的武道服，手指紧紧攥成拳，指节泛白。他能清晰地听见身边人的窃窃私语，那些话语像海风一样，无孔不入。
“看，又是那个贾黑米，三年了，气血还在四十多晃悠，真是块烂泥。”
“废柴就是废柴，占着武道馆的名额，浪费资源。”
“听说他爸妈当年就是被诡异弄死的，指不定他身上也沾了邪气，所以气血才涨不上去。”
“离他远点，别被晦气沾到，影响我的气血突破。”
贾黑米咬着牙，把所有的声音都咽进肚子里。
他不怪别人嘲讽，只恨自己不争气。他也想气血破百，想考上武道大学，想变强，想查清父母死亡的真相，想保护那些和他一样底层的人。可他的身体就像一个漏了底的容器，无论怎么运转基础气血法，那点微薄的灵气都留不住，更别说转化成实打实的气血之力。
“下一个，王虎！”
测试仪前的监考老师面无表情地喊了一声，一个身材壮硕的少年大步上前，手掌重重按在测试仪的感应面板上。淡蓝色的光芒瞬间亮起，数字飞速跳动，最终停在八十九的位置。

“不错，比上月涨了五点，继续努力，下个月争取破九十。”老师微微点头，语气里带着赞许。
王虎得意地扫了一眼队伍末尾的贾黑米，扬着下巴走了下来，路过贾黑米身边时，故意撞了他一下，冷笑道：“废物，看什么看？你这辈子都别想摸到八十的边。”
贾黑米踉跄了一下，稳住身形，没说话，只是眼底深处，藏着一丝不甘的火焰。
他不是不能忍，只是忍得越久，那股想要冲破命运枷锁的念头就越强烈。
队伍一点点往前挪，气血测试仪的数字不断刷新，七十、八十、九十，偶尔有一两个突破九十的，都会引来一阵羡慕的惊呼。凰溪岛只是边境小岛，能气血破九十的少年，已经算是天才苗子，有很大希望通过高考预选。
而人群中，最耀眼的，永远是那个站在第一排的少女。
才依依。
她一身白色武道服，身姿挺拔如松，肌肤白皙，眉眼清冷，一头乌黑的长发束成高马尾，浑身上下都透着一股生人勿近的孤傲。她是凰溪岛乃至周边三座基地市公认的武道天才，年仅十八岁，气血值早已突破一百二十，序列异能也提前觉醒，是武道馆重点培养的对象，更是注定要考入全国顶尖武道大学的天之骄女。
从始至终，才依依都没有看队伍末尾一眼，仿佛贾黑米这样的废柴，连让她侧目一秒的资格都没有。
贾黑米的目光，却忍不住悄悄落在她的身上。
不是爱慕，而是一种近乎仰望的羡慕。
他羡慕她天生的强悍气血，羡慕她觉醒的序列异能，羡慕她站在阳光里，被所有人追捧，而自己，只能躲在阴影里，承受着无尽的嘲讽与轻视。
“下一个，贾黑米！”
终于，监考老师的声音响起，带着毫不掩饰的不耐烦。
整个武道场瞬间安静了一瞬，随后爆发出一阵哄笑。
“哈哈，废物终于上场了！”
“我赌五毛，还是四十二，多一点都没有！”
“测了也是白测，浪费时间，赶紧下来吧！”
贾黑米深吸一口气，压下心头的翻涌，一步步走到测试仪前。

Early mornings on Huangxi Island are always enveloped by a layer of pale golden sun. The salty sea breeze carries the unique floral fragrance of the resort and passes over the bluestone floor of the Binhai Martial Arts Center.
At this moment, the huge martial arts arena was already crowded with people. Thickly packed young and girls were dressed in uniform black martial arts uniforms with the emblem of the Huangxi Island Martial Arts Hall printed on their chests. Their faces were tense, and their eyes were fixed on the half-person-high qi and blood tester in the center of the arena.
Today is the day for the monthly qi and blood retest at the Huangxi Island Martial Arts Hall.
For this group of teenagers who are about to take the martial arts college entrance examination, their health is their fate, their future, and the only ticket to climb from the bottom to the martial arts university in the main city. A hundred years after the spiritual energy was revived, Blue Star has already divided the classes by strength. A person who breaks 100 points of blood is the threshold for martial arts. If he breaks 300 points, he can enter a third-rate school. If he breaks 500 points, he can enter a top martial arts university. If he has less than 500 points, he is a martial arts loser who has been sentenced to death. He can only be trapped at the bottom of Huangxi Island for the rest of his life. He may even be swallowed by strange beasts on the wasteland border at any time, or be dragged into the spiritual hell by the strange things deep in the city.
Jiahemi stood at the end of the line, hunching his shoulders and trying to make himself less conspicuous.
He is eighteen years old and is a native of Huangxi Island. His parents died in a sudden "tourist madness incident" when he was ten years old. Later, he learned that it was not madness, but the whisper of the evil god that gnawed through the hole in his soul, turning him into an irrational walking zombie. Since then, Jia Heimi has been struggling to survive by working odd jobs in small restaurants on the island. He lives in the most dilapidated fishing hut in the resort area, gnaws on dry and hard noodles every day, and collects money to go to the martial arts hall to practice the lowest level of Qi and blood training.
But talent is never unreasonable.
Jia Heimi's qi and blood level remained unchanged for three years from the time he was measured at 42 at the age of fifteen.
Forty-two.
He was stuck under the cordon and was not even qualified to participate in the preliminaries for the martial arts college entrance examination.
The looks around her ranged from ridicule to contempt to indifference, like thin needles pricking Jiahemi's back. He lowered his head and looked at his washed white martial arts uniform. He clenched his fingers tightly into fists and his knuckles turned white. He could clearly hear the whispers of the people around him, and those words were as pervasive as the sea breeze.
"Look, it's that Jia Heimi again. It's been three years and his blood is still in his forties. What a piece of shit."
"A loser is a loser, taking up spots in the martial arts gym and wasting resources."
"I heard that his parents were killed by weirdness back then. Maybe he was also stained with evil energy, so his energy and blood couldn't rise."
"Stay away from him, don't let the bad luck affect my Qi and blood breakthrough."
Jiahemi gritted his teeth and swallowed all the sounds.
He doesn't blame others for ridiculing, he only blames himself for not living up to expectations. He also wants to have a hundred qi and blood, to be admitted to a martial arts university, to become stronger, to find out the truth behind the death of his parents, and to protect those at the same low level as him. But his body was like a leaky container. No matter how he used the basic Qi and blood method, he couldn't retain the meager amount of spiritual energy, let alone convert it into real Qi and blood power.
"Next, Wang Hu!"
The invigilator in front of the tester shouted expressionlessly, and a sturdy young man strode forward and pressed his palm heavily on the sensor panel of the tester. The light blue light lit up instantly, and the numbers jumped rapidly, finally stopping at eighty-nine.
"Not bad, it's five points higher than last month. Keep working hard and strive to break 90 next month." The teacher nodded slightly, with approval in his tone.
Wang Hu glanced proudly at Jia Heimi, who was at the end of the team, and walked down with his chin raised. When he passed by Jia Heimi, he deliberately bumped into him and sneered: "Trash, what are you looking at? You will never touch the edge of eighty in your life."
Jia Heimi staggered, stabilized his figure, and said nothing, but there was a trace of unwilling flame hidden deep in his eyes.
It’s not that he can’t bear it, it’s just that the longer he endures it, the moreThe stronger the desire to break through the shackles of fate.
The team moved forward little by little, and the numbers on the qi and blood tester kept refreshing, seventy, eighty, ninety, and occasionally one or two exceeded ninety, which would attract a burst of envious exclamations. Huangxi Island is just a small border island. A young man with a vitality of over ninety is considered a genius and has a high chance of passing the preliminaries for the college entrance examination.
And among the crowd, the most dazzling one is always the girl standing in the first row.
Cai Yiyi.
She was dressed in a white martial arts uniform, with a figure as tall as a pine tree, fair skin, cold eyebrows, long black hair tied into a high ponytail, and an aloofness that kept strangers away from her. She is recognized as a martial arts genius on Huangxi Island and even the three surrounding base cities. She is only 18 years old, her health value has already exceeded 120, and her sequence abilities have been awakened in advance. She is a key training target of the martial arts hall, and she is destined to be admitted to the top martial arts university in the country.
From the beginning to the end, Cai Yiyi never glanced at the end of the team, as if a loser like Jia Heimi was not qualified to look at her for even a second.
Jia Heimi's eyes couldn't help but fall on her quietly.
Not admiration, but a kind of envy that is almost admiration.
He envied her natural strength and blood, envied her awakened sequence powers, envied her standing in the sun and being sought after by everyone, while he could only hide in the shadows, enduring endless ridicule and contempt.
"Next, Jahmi!"
Finally, the voice of the invigilator sounded, with undisguised impatience.
The entire martial arts field was quiet for a moment, and then burst into laughter.
"Haha, the trash finally comes on stage!"
"I bet fifty cents, it's still forty-two, nothing more!"
"It's a useless test. It's a waste of time. Come down quickly!"
Jia Heimi took a deep breath, suppressed the turmoil in his heart, and walked step by step to the tester.
